rationale: Bands preserve sharp checks and role colours; a gradient stop expresses the shine without raster assets.

design_guidelines.artistic_direction: A crisp racing checkerboard with one restrained travelling shine.
design_guidelines.concept_twist: The familiar finish-line checker becomes a role-coloured living race surface.
design_guidelines.body_strategy: Two-cell checks simplify at the 4-cell spawn, establish rhythm by 6-7 cells, and repeat cleanly through long turns while the head glow stays above tail material.
design_guidelines.asset_strategy: Procedural layers only; there are no raster seams or sprite-frame rows to produce.

layer_plan: Outline and Body fallback ribbons establish role reading
Upper check and Lower check bands form the board
Shine gradient travels without changing topology
animation_plan: Move three gradient stops with tri(time) over a 2400ms period
risks: Check marks may collapse on a one-cell snake, so patterned layers omit there
